method: Pins (maps.json, RDOMap singleplayer.json exact points, game coords) are linked to text items (collectibles.json) only when the item text names a place whose position exists in open (Unlicense) RDOMap label data (discoverables text labels, shops.json wardrobe points, interiors.json, fasttravels.json), and the nearest pin of that set to that label is within 450 units and either (high) the next-nearest pin is at least 2.5x as far and 400+ units farther with any stated compass direction matching, or (high) it is a mutual nearest match within 150 units, or (medium) the text's compass direction is satisfied only by the nearest pin and the next-nearest is 1.5x+ as far, or the next-nearest is 2x+ as far and 400+ units farther. No open state/region polygons exist, so region-elimination was not used. Label anchors are approximate. Pin numbering is the dataset's and unrelated to guide numbering.
